fact: The Direct Social Aid scheme, in force since December 2023 and managed by CNSS and CNRA, relies on a fully digitalised process through the Registre social unifié, and nearly 4 million families had benefited by end-August 2025.
title: Aides sociales : ce qui change pour les familles dès la fin novembre
publisher: Le Matin, republished by Agence Nationale du Soutien Social
